spec.name: iotf_device_energy_hourly
spec.query:
sourceBucket = "energy"
targetBucket = "energy_agg"

base = (field) =>
  from(bucket: sourceBucket)
    |> range(start: -2h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_energy_raw")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == field)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.user_id and exists r.device_id)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value", "device_id", "user_id"])
    |> group(columns: ["device_id", "user_id"], mode: "by")

base(field: "energy")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "device_energy_hourly")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "energy_sum_wh")
  |> to(bucket: targetBucket)

base(field: "power")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "device_energy_hourly")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "power_avg_w")
  |> to(bucket: targetBucket)

base(field: "power")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "device_energy_hourly")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "power_max_w")
  |> to(bucket: targetBucket)

base(field: "energy")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
  |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "device_energy_hourly")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "sample_count")
  |> to(bucket: targetBucket)
